title: Azure Functions Execution Failures

description: Failed function executions break event-driven workflows. This UC monitors `azure:monitor:resource` for azure functions execution failures and surfaces events for SOC triage, change review, and compliance evidence.
value: Azure Functions Execution Failures impacts serverless SLOs and cost efficiency. Detecting azure functions execution failures early reduces mean time to contain cloud incidents, supports audit logging controls, and prevents silent misconfiguration drift across accounts.
implementation: Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=azure sourcetype=azure:monitor:resource.
visualization: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report.
knownFalsePositives: Approved change windows; documented automation service principals; sandbox accounts excluded via lookup.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=azure`.
• Install and configure Provider serverless monitoring via cloud TA with the modular input for `azure:monitor:resource`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.5.16.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `ResourceId` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=azure sourcetype=azure:monitor:resource.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=azure sourcetype="azure:monitor:resource" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=azure sourcetype="azure:monitor:resource" operationName="Microsoft.*Execution Failures"
| table _time ResourceId metricName total average
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.5.20_azure_functions_executio_20"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `azure:monitor:resource` in `index=azure` to detect azure functions execution failures. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the Azure portal Metrics explorer for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `ResourceId` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_5_20_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Provider serverless monitoring via cloud TA and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of azure functions execution failures so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
